snippet.title: A show she never watched. | Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Clara, a teenager struggling with psychological issues, is visited one night by a mysterious entity through her TV. As she falls asleep, She begins her perilous adventure in her dreams. Will she be able to discover the truth? Or will she continue to dream for eternity?

This video is to announce our first video game 
===========
A wishlist will help us a lot!

- Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837360/A_show_she_never_watched/
- Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/autnKY2Gjw

- Website page: https://sourcemacchiato.com/games/a-show-she-never-watched/
===========
